zh: 这页接在 R0.00–R0.60 的阶段回顾之后，完整保留 R0.61 到 R0.72W 的 113 个研究节点。R0.72W 先证明 finite H5/H7/R9 termwise absorption 在整条扩张周期上为 false，再以 full analytic sine tail、compact--escaping cell dichotomy 和 torus H^-1 direct sum 闭合 exact periodic scalar collision-block contraction。节点状态只描述声明范围内的证据，不把一个 linear scalar block 写成 outer-time、complete linearized、nonlinear 或 Clay 结论。
en: This page follows the R0.00–R0.60 phase recap and fully retains 113 research nodes from R0.61 through R0.72W. R0.72W first proves that finite H5/H7/R9 termwise absorption is false over the entire expanding period, then closes exact periodic scalar collision-block contraction using the full analytic sine tail, the compact--escaping cell dichotomy, and a torus H^-1 direct sum. Node statuses describe evidence only within the declared scope and do not turn one linear scalar block into an outer-time, complete-linearized, nonlinear, or Clay conclusion.
